name: Regenerate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points, then 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for an hour.
text: The target regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points at once. For the next hour it also regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns, and lost body parts grow back after 2 minutes.
